Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant position at Kannur University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Assistant position at Kannur University is 30-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in any branch of Life Science, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Agriculture, or an M.Tech. or M.Pharm. degree.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 32 years. Additionally, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for women candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Written Test, Skill/Trade Test, Presentation, and Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What documents do I need to attach with my email application?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
